title: Commits per week, March–October 2026, by workstream
caption: Human-authored commits per week across every sim-racing repository, deduplicated across repos that absorbed one another; CI-bot commits excluded. Peak week 20–26 April: 316.
method: git log of 26 cloned repositories plus the reflogs of three local-only repos; dates bucketed in America/Denver; sessions are runs of commits less than 45 minutes apart.
